finalists.label: Sweet's syndrome
finalists.why: Skin biopsy showed dermal neutrophils with upper dermal edema and a subepidermal blister, consistent with bullous Sweet’s syndrome.

finalists.label: Anemia of Chronic Disease
finalists.why: Low hemoglobin and ferritin levels are consistent with anemia of chronic disease.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of a pustular rash and skin biopsy findings consistent with bullous Sweet’s syndrome provide strong evidence for this diagnosis.

support_spans: Skin biopsy showed dermal neutrophils with upper dermal edema and a subepidermal blister, consistent with bullous Sweet’s syndrome

contradict_spans: She was given a presumptive diagnosis of immune thrombocytopenia in pregnancy. Her fatigue persisted but she had no bleeding complications

support_spans: a family history of thyroid disease and systemic lupus erythematosus
